description: Defines the ProductAttribute class, which extends Entity and implements Serializable. It models a product attribute with associated option and option value objects, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProductAttribute
classes.description: Represents a product attribute with associated option and value, extending Entity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the ProductOptionValue associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Returns the ProductOptionValue associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: setOption
methods.description: Sets the ProductOption associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns the ProductOption associated with this product attribute.
